judul: Lightweight YOLOv8n Segmentation and ShuffleNetV2 Transfer Learning Integration for Oil Palm Fruit Ripeness Classification
sumber: International Conference on Information and Communications Technology Icoiact
abstrak: The classification of palm oil ripeness is crucial to ensure optimal quality of crude palm oil (CPO) production. Traditional manual assessments are inconsistent and resource-intensive, which means an automated solution is preferred. Also, a lightweight architecture is required to be used in the fields without internet connection. The dataset was divided into 70% for training, 20% for testing, and 10% for validation to ensure reliable model performance assessment. This paper proposes image segmentation as a means of preprocessing images and evaluates an enhanced combination of a segmentor and classifier for palm oil ripeness classification. The finding shows up to a 6.58 % increase in accuracy when using segmentation. The best combination, being YOLOv8n-Segmentation along with Shuf-fletNetV2, achieves 98.07% accuracy, 98.13% precision, 98.07% recall, and 98.08 % Fl-score, offering a computationally efficient and high-performance approach, suitable as an assistant for palm oil farmers. Future work should focus on expanding dataset as well as a more of combinations for segmentation and classification models.
